description: This file defines the EventHubBatchContainer class which implements the IBatchContainer interface to represent a batch of events from Azure Event Hubs within Orleans streaming framework. It manages serialization, payload handling, and conversion of events to EventData format, and includes internal classes and methods for batch processing and request context management.

classes.name: EventHubBatchContainer
classes.description: Represents a batch of EventHub events with associated stream metadata, supporting serialization, deserialization, and event extraction functionalities within Orleans streams.

classes.name: EventHubBatchContainer.Body
classes.description: Internal class modeling the payload containing events and request context for batch serialization.

methods.name: EventHubBatchContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the batch container with event message and serializer, setting the sequence token.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events of a specific type from the batch, associating each with a sequence token.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the request context from the batch payload into the current execution context.

methods.name: ToEventData
methods.description: Creates an EventData object from a set of events, stream id, and request context.

methods.name: UpdateEventData
methods.description: Populates an EventData object with serialized events and stream namespace information.

methods.name: CreateEventDataBody
methods.description: Serializes the payload containing events and request context into a byte array for event data payload.
